hazards.evidence: The bed height appears too low, which may make it difficult for someone using a walker to sit down or stand up safely.
Insufficient walker clearance around the bed, particularly on the side near the wall and around the foot of the bed.
Cord from the lamp is visible on the floor, posing a tripping hazard.
The carpet may not be securely fastened to the floor, posing a potential tripping hazard.
